bgk_model.K_valid_tokens_per_BG: 1 or 2, encoded by emitted BG input bursts; channel MAC service uses maximum 2

Q_DRAM_refill.source: rank0/BG0, four bank-index sources per channel
Q_DRAM_refill.scheduling: conservative serial RD return then WRGB relay; one composite in flight
Q_DRAM_refill.read_completion: native ordinary RD with ACT/PRE and CL+BL return
Q_DRAM_refill.relay_completion: charged shared-path WRGB + nBL_min; same bank index in every BG/rank
Q_DRAM_refill.callback: after relay completion only; no GPU round trip

bgk_model.Q_multicast: same bank-index in every BG/rank; independent bank-local double-buffer ownership
bgk_model.input_ready: WRGB issue + nBL_min; consumers wait for every target bank and every queued same-slot fill
bgk_model.MAC_completion: new MACK/MACQK complete at issue + nCCDK/nCCDQK, native array cadence applies independently
bgk_model.BG_reduction: implicit lockstep four-bank reduction sustains MAC; RD_BG waits for BG compute readiness; final-fragment dependency in trace
bgk_model.local_write: Bank-local array access with native row/recovery constraints and shared rank CA

completion_policy: Input ST completes at native WR issue+CWL+BLmax+WR; SEAL waits for all declared columns; staged local reads and SRF multicast complete within nCL+nBL_min with rank CA arbitration; native per-bank GEMV fill/consume/release and global BARRIER completion fences

local_input_model.scope: selected rank only; independent rank-local ports
local_input_model.completion: issue + cycles_per_burst; MAC waits for selected buffer readiness
local_input_model.source: already-ready Z in rank-local SRAM; gather/GELU/product/cast not computed
local_input_model.assumption: declared configurable local port, not an LPDDR specification or measured NL unit

pim_model.scope: MACAB addressed rank; RDRES per rank; WRGB targets depend on input_broadcast
pim_model.transfer_scheduling: GPU broadcast inputs first use ordinary WR to rank1 BG0/B0 and BG1/B0 DRAM; all writes complete before local loads. Fragments alternate source banks; local read/broadcast/compute commands share rank CA.
pim_model.mac_timing_basis: explicit local-array ACT/PRE/refresh/column constraints; no inherited external RD DQ/CAS/rank-turnaround constraints

channel_mac.trace: one rank-0 MACAB with explicit BUFFER; command Rank=-1 targets all ranks
channel_mac.activation: ACTAB/PREab prerequisites cover every target bank and rank
channel_mac.readiness: actual MAC waits for every target input; ACT/PRE may prepare earlier
channel_mac.assumptions: one shared CA command fans out to all ranks with no extra delay; local PEs/SRAM/accumulators operate concurrently

half_bank.scope: addressed half of bank groups in the addressed channel/rank
half_bank.gpu_read_overlap: ordinary LD to the complementary half; unchanged read timings

pim_model.issue_interval_basis: nCCDL (same-BG column interval), unless explicitly overridden
pim_model.mac_completion: Native completion: eight CK for Q/K projection and token-sharded V at [131072,163840), sixteen CK for legacy V, PV, Gate/Up and GPU-fed Down; the bank PE is shared by both input slots
pim_model.double_buffer: One 1KiB physical SRF; fill all valid 256B/512B views before compute; consume the complete batch before any overwrite
pim_model.pe_clock_model: external; PE throughput assumed sufficient for the configured MAC interval
pim_model.buffer_transfer_basis: GPU ordinary WR to two source banks; source-bank-to-SRF and rank SRF multicast via internal LOCALRD

input_broadcast.completion: issue + nBL_min makes every target buffer ready (AttAcc)
input_broadcast.ownership: every target slot must be free before issuing a broadcast
input_broadcast.dq_accounting: one 32B burst per WRGB; delivered bytes counted separately
input_broadcast.limitations: assumed internal fanout and sufficient SRAM ports; no broadcast network/energy model; no cross-channel or result broadcast

bank_input_multicast.completion: After source-bank DRAM column read; bank-to-SRF and rank multicast latency included in nCL+nBL_min
bank_input_multicast.source: Dedicated rank1 BG0/B0 and BG1/B0 DRAM staging

unified_gemv_model.external_multicast: Entire operator input written once per rank across two source banks before any SRF fill; no direct GPU-to-SRF multicast
unified_gemv_model.port_sharing: Staging local read, SRF broadcast and compute arbitrate on one rank command bus
unified_gemv_model.ffn_dataflow: Gate/Up FP32 outputs return to GPU; GPU GeLU/elementwise multiply/BF16 cast is an excluded value-ready boundary; GPU sends full4096-feature Z to each rank, whose banks multiply resident Down weights
unified_gemv_model.down_layout: Output partition:64 complete output features per rank,4 per bank; complete128KiB GPU Z staged across two64KiB source-bank regions
unified_gemv_model.completion: Native MAC completion covers eight Q/K/token-sharded-V rows or sixteen legacy-V/PV/Gate/Up/Down rows; slot release is explicit

token_sharded_v_geometry.selection: Recognized by the MAC weight address; legacy V region remains supported

unified_gemv_model.assumption: Bank-to-SRF and intra-rank SRF multicast data latency included in DRAM column-read completion; distinct command arbitration still charged
unified_gemv_model.input_staging_location: DRAM, separate from the unchanged1KiB per-bank GEMV SRAM
unified_gemv_model.input_staging_layout: fragment f maps to BG=f%2, bank0, physical offset=524288+(floor(f/2)*rows+token)*32

rank_dispatch_model.requests_total_basis: Trace requests including one parent per rank descriptor; child operations counted separately

v_cache_model.prefix_precondition: Existing prefix resident in token-parity layout
v_cache_model.suffix_update: Per bank/feature: LOCALRD32 -> gather8 FP32 (32B) -> cast8 BF16 (16B) -> LOCALWR32 RMW

o_projection_model.final_reduction: GPU sum over eight heads and two KV parity partials; latency unmeasured
